npcs.name: Pikachu Mum
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly time to go home now so I better round up my kids!
npcs.repeat_text: We come back here every day because they're all so obsessed with Pikachu!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
npcs.meet_text: I've never even been on a surfboard before.
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could surf like a Pikachu!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
npcs.meet_text: I've still not seen a Pikachu fly!
npcs.repeat_text: I wish I could go flying toooo.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
npcs.meet_text: I've been taking some good pictures on my camera recently.
npcs.repeat_text: I'm still working on my Pikachu picture collection. I currently don't have many.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
npcs.meet_text: I've still got my eyes open trying to find a Pikachu here!
npcs.repeat_text: Please tell me if you find a Pikachu running around here!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
npcs.meet_text: Thunderbolt is such a super duper powerful attack.
npcs.repeat_text: I would never want to be shocked by a real Thunderbolt!!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
npcs.repeat_text: I love Pikachu the most out of all of us!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Marina
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly time to go home so I won't have time to battle now.
npcs.repeat_text: Mum brings us back every day

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Skye
npcs.meet_text: I always want to battle but mum doesn't let us when it's this late.
npcs.repeat_text: We always come here early in the morning.

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Cami
npcs.meet_text: I'm trying to take some last minute photos before we have to leave.
npcs.repeat_text: I'll bring my cards back here tomorrow with the photos I've taken!

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Juniper
npcs.meet_text: I swear I just saw a Pikachu run along by here!!
npcs.repeat_text: I don't have long to find it before I have to go

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Raye
npcs.meet_text: I know our mum worries about us when it gets this late so I better head back
npcs.repeat_text: We have to be back home before it gets dark

npcs.name: Pikachu Fan Leaf
npcs.meet_text: Oh dear I've just noticed the time so I can't play any more
npcs.repeat_text: We're not allowed to play when it gets dark

npcs.name: VF 5,7,8 D,E Rocket Pack Gift
npcs.meet_text: I'm glad we can finally get our hands on these packs. You look like you haven't opened many of these so have one on me. Spread the word you can buy them here.
npcs.repeat_text: Hope you pulled something good from that.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Proton
opponents.meet_text: This well is bringing back a lot of memories... I can't imagine you've heard of Team Rocket before but you'll hear about us soon.
opponents.first_win_text: Heh we're in your shadow then huh.
opponents.rematch_win_text: It won't always be like this.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Petrel
opponents.meet_text: Heh, you've found us at the right time. We've been hiding from the police... Not that we've done anything illegal, we're just here to play this card game.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should join us, we've got big things coming.
opponents.loss_text: Of course you didn't stand a chance against us.

opponents.name: Rocket Exec Archer
opponents.meet_text: Hello. I'm Archer one of the 4 execs of Team Rocket. We're not here to do anything illicit. Not yet anyway. We're just getting started.
opponents.repeat_text: If you're really that interested you should join us.
opponents.first_win_text: Enjoy the wins while they last.

opponents.name: Mad Scientist Leonard
opponents.meet_text: I'm right on the edge of finishing my best invention, it's going to change the world.
opponents.repeat_text: I still haven't figure out the right formulas yet.
opponents.first_win_text: I just can't seem to get the right formula. I need more assistants
opponents.rematch_win_text: You could defintely help me with this.
opponents.loss_text: Remember my name, I'll be all over every scientific news outlet soon!

opponents.name: Lady Fiona
opponents.meet_text: There's always beauty to be found in even the most seemingly ugly things.
opponents.repeat_text: Life and everything in it is beauty.
opponents.first_win_text: Wouldn't you agree that ugliness can still be beautiful?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I always love to see the beauty in things.
opponents.loss_text: I'm not just a pretty face either.

opponents.name: Card Expert Nathan
opponents.meet_text: Fire Pokemon are my favourite. They're so strong.
opponents.first_win_text: Fire Pokemon are strong but they still have their weaknesses
opponents.rematch_win_text: It's not just about having strong Pokemon
opponents.loss_text: Nothing can beat the strongest Pokemon

opponents.name: Backpacker Patrick
opponents.meet_text: I've been all over the world and seen a lot of different places.
opponents.repeat_text: Nothing like putting on a backpack and going exploring
opponents.loss_text: Carrying all this weight makes me stronger in every sense

opponents.name: Hiker Walter
opponents.meet_text: I've been travelling for hours, for days on end. I hike everywhere. It's a lot of hard work but I see a lot.
opponents.repeat_text: My legs are still aching, need a rest.
opponents.first_win_text: I should have taken my hiking backpack off, I couldn't concentrate.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm still too focused on the hike and not the game.
opponents.loss_text: If you hike everywhere like me you learn how to do a lot.

opponents.name: Light Engineer Chase
opponents.meet_text: My boss called me out to fix these lights but I arrived and they're all working? What a waste of my time but at least I'm being paid so fancy a match?
opponents.repeat_text: I can't leave this early or I won't be paid
opponents.first_win_text: Being paid to be beaten, well I'm not complaining.
opponents.loss_text: Well I'm glad I didn't have to do any work now!

opponents.name: Fossil Expert Jonathan
opponents.meet_text: There's a lot of history in this forest, it's been around for thousands of years.
opponents.repeat_text: You haven't found any mysterious artifacts around here have you?
opponents.first_win_text: We can learn a lot of things from the past.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Even losses are a great way to learn.
opponents.loss_text: You're a thing of the past!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Brock
opponents.meet_text: I'm Brock, the Ex Gym Leader of Pewter City and expert on Rock-type Pokemon. I'm practicing hard before the challenge begins. Did you know about the ruleset? Some trainer cards are banned for the challenge so you can't use them in your deck. Show me your best.
opponents.repeat_text: I really enjoyed our last match. Want to give it another shot?
opponents.first_win_text: You overcame my rock hard defence!
opponents.rematch_win_text: Looks like you're the stronger one.
opponents.loss_text: The best offense is a good defense! That's my way of doing things!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Lt. Surge
opponents.meet_text: Hey Kid, you're in for a shock if you think you can beat me at the Gym Challenge. You'll need to hold your nerve against me. I'm using the Gym Challenge rules, so don't think about using any banned trainer cards.
opponents.first_win_text: Even my electric tricks lost. You're good at this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: When it comes to Electric type Pokemon, I'm number one. Card games? Clearly not so much hahaha.

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Sabrina
opponents.meet_text: I had a vision of your arrival! My name is Sabrina. I have had psychic powers since I was a child. You're here to play against me. I will grant you a match.
opponents.repeat_text: I knew you would return and this too shall not be the last time we meet.
opponents.first_win_text: This loss shocks me! But a loss is a loss. I admit I didn't work hard enough to win.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Your power... It far exceeds what I foresaw... Maybe it isn't possible to fully predict what the future holds...
opponents.loss_text: This turned out exactly as I had predicted.
